reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction omits public visibility and map/summary views, which are covered by other HLGs.

decisions.rationale: The source supports citizen participation as a broad outcome; the reconstruction mismatch concerns its children.
decisions.outcome_justification: Citizen submits and interacts with reports, fostering civic engagement, while other HLGs cover visibility and transparency.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction accurately reflects the dual-view access and metadata capabilities.

decisions.rationale: The source explicitly supports transparent reporting; equivalence confirms its autonomy.
decisions.outcome_justification: Citizen views reports on a map and summary table, enabling transparency distinct from participation or communication.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction captures multi-channel notifications and direct messaging comprehensively.

decisions.rationale: The source supports real-time communication as an independent outcome; equivalence validates its legitimacy.
decisions.outcome_justification: Citizen receives updates and messages, building trust, separate from reporting or visibility.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction matches public, anonymous access to statistics and map.

decisions.rationale: The source supports non-registered user access as a distinct outcome; equivalence confirms its necessity.
decisions.outcome_justification: Non-registered users view public data, promoting awareness without requiring participation or registration.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction accurately reflects review and rejection with justification.

decisions.rationale: The source supports efficient review as an independent staff responsibility; equivalence validates its autonomy.
decisions.outcome_justification: Organization Office reviews and rejects reports, ensuring accountability distinct from assignment or management.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction captures lifecycle management, status tracking, and external updates.

decisions.rationale: The source supports report assignment and management as a distinct technical outcome; equivalence confirms its necessity.
decisions.outcome_justification: Technical Office assigns and manages reports based on category, ensuring resolution separate from review or statistics.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction matches public and private statistical insights.

decisions.rationale: The source supports statistical insights as an independent administrative outcome; equivalence validates its legitimacy.
decisions.outcome_justification: Municipal Administrator views trends and performance analytics, distinct from open-source release or report assignment.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction accurately reflects open-source publication and configuration.

decisions.rationale: The source supports open-source availability as a distinct administrative outcome; equivalence confirms its necessity.
decisions.outcome_justification: Municipal Administrator releases the system as open-source, separate from statistical or assignment responsibilities.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction captures automated assignment rules, validation, and compliance.

decisions.rationale: The source describes this as a configuration capability for the Municipal Administrator; the current HLG over-specifies implementation (automated system).
decisions.outcome_justification: Municipal Administrator configures assignment rules, while the current HLG conflates configuration with system automation.
decisions.rewriting_focus: Reframe to focus solely on configuring automatic assignment rules without mentioning system implementation or triggers.
